text:
Marathon Petroleum gained 0.71% today, continuing a strong run that has seen the stock climb nearly 9% over two weeks. The gain sits squarely within the broader oil refining tailwind: U.S. crude has jumped more than 9% this week alone as Iran and the U.S. have traded military strikes, pushing oil prices higher and driving refineries to run at 98% capacity — near maximum utilization. For a refiner like Marathon, higher crude prices and fuller refinery operations translate directly to wider profit margins and stronger throughput.

The setup remains favorable for refiners more broadly. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East continue to support oil prices well above $90 per barrel, while gasoline and diesel inventories are at moderate levels — tightness that benefits processors. The stock's gains this week reflect the market pricing in sustained demand and refinery profitability amid ongoing regional instability.
